Description: We are going to be continuing operation of a Cafe in the location where Bartavelle was with a menu and offering that is similar to the previous business at this location. We will offer coffee, tea, lemons and other beverages. As well as reselling pastries from local bakers in Berkeley and some salads and sandwiches. We plan to purchase the liquor license that the former Bartavelle business has and sell beer, cider and wine as part of our offering but only after the license transfer has been completed. Staff Additional Comment: Food service with incidential beer and wine sales for on site consumption.

Description: Ashby Village (a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt nonprofit organization (EIN: 27-2174330)) is a vibrant community built by and for older adults from different backgrounds and lived experiences. We're dedicated to the neighborly practice of helping each other stay connected and navigate life’s curves to make aging easier, enriching and fun. With the support of volunteers that span five generations, we're living with purpose and self-determination in the diverse, multi-generational neighborhoods we call home. Together, we're committed to building an inclusive membership organization and culture that advances access to practical services, support, and social programs for older adults from all backgrounds and economic means. We're transforming how we age. Members of our thriving village community live in Albany, Berkeley, El Cerrito, Emeryville, Kensington, Oakland, and Richmond.
